title: Maat: Independent Deterministic Contract-Based Governance for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
title_zh: Maat: 独立确定性合同基础治理多代理大型语言模型工作流

paragraphs.en: Large-language-model multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) introduce a characteristic reliability problem: an error produced by one agent can be accepted as context by downstream agents and propagate across the workflow. Recent studies have documented inter-agent misalignment, error cascades, silent trajectory failures, and architecture-dependent error amplification, motivating verification at agent boundaries rather than only on final outputs. Many proposed safeguards, however, rely on learned or LLM-based judges whose verdicts are themselves probabilistic and can inherit the failure modes they are meant to catch; we ask whether a deterministic layer can instead stop contract-detectable handoff defects. We present Maat , a runtime governance layer that validates agent-to-agent handoffs against a versioned workflow contract, or anchor , with no language model in the validation or scoring path. We evaluated the approach in six controlled domain workflows (6–15 agents, 522 trials) with injected data-level defects and a deterministic seven-check rubric. Version 1 of this article reported rubric gains in all six workflows (2.9–26.5%). A post-publication audit found that three benchmark scorers credited any early halt as a prevented defect, so false-alarm halts were counted as catches. On paired trials in which the governed run either completed or halted on a finding attributable to a verified defect, the rubric score changes by +7.7% to +29.1% in five workflows and is flat in software development (+0.8%); model-call cost falls by 17–53% where attributable halts occur early. A hand review of all 94 governed-arm halts found 35 false alarms (37%), caused by validator defects rather than model behaviour; when those halts are counted as failed work, the governed arm scores below the ungoverned arm in four of six workflows. Protection therefore depends on correct contract and validator configuration, and halt attribution must itself be verified. The results support deterministic handoff validation as complementary to post-hoc failure attribution, learned guardrails, and agent-based verification; they do not establish universal correctness, hallucination detection, or model-independent effectiveness. We conclude with a model-dependence hypothesis and a cross-model validation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）引入了一个典型的可靠性问题：一个智能体产生的错误可能被下游智能体作为上下文接受，并在工作流中持续传播。 近期研究记录了智能体之间的不一致、错误级联、静默轨迹故障以及依赖架构的错误放大现象，这促使人们将验证重点从仅检查最终输出转向智能体边界。 然而，许多已提出的防护机制依赖于经过训练或基于大型语言模型的判断器，而这些判断器的判定本身具有概率性，并可能继承它们本应检测到的故障模式；我们提出疑问：是否可以用一个确定性层来阻止合同可检测的交接缺陷？ 我们提出了 Maat——一个运行时治理层，它依据版本化的工作流合同（或称“锚点”）验证智能体间的交接过程，且验证与评分路径中不包含任何语言模型。 我们在六个受控领域的工作流中（包含 6–15 个智能体，共 522 次试验）评估了该方法，通过注入数据层缺陷并使用一个确定性的七项检查评分标准进行测试。 本文第一版报告称，该评分标准在全部六个工作流中均提升了分数（提升幅度为 2.9%–26.5%）。 一篇发表后的审计发现，三个基准评分器将任何提前终止都计为“已阻止的缺陷”，因此误报导致的提前终止也被错误地计为成功拦截。 在成对试验中，当受治理的运行流程因经验证的缺陷而完成或提前终止时，评分标准分数在五个工作流中分别提升了 +7.7% 至 +29.1%，而在软件开发领域则无变化（+0.8%）；若提前终止可归因于此类缺陷，模型调用成本会下降 17%–53%。 对所有 94 个治理组中的提前终止案例进行人工审查后发现，其中 35 例为误报（占比 37%），其根本原因是验证器缺陷而非模型行为；若将这些提前终止视为工作失败，则在六个工作流中有四个的治理组得分低于无治理组。 因此，防护效果取决于合同和验证器的正确配置，且对提前终止的原因归因本身也必须经过验证。 研究结果表明，确定性的交接验证可作为事后故障归因、学习型防护机制和基于智能体的验证方法的补充；但并未证明其具有普适正确性、幻觉检测能力或模型无关的有效性。 最后，我们提出了一个关于模型依赖性的假设，并设计了一个跨模型的验证协议。

paragraphs.en: Revision note (v2). Version 1 stated that a protective halt was credited only when the associated finding corresponded to the injected defect. The deterministic scorers for the B2B, hospital-triage and software-development benchmarks did not implement this: any halt before the final artefact received full marks. The insurance and e-commerce scorers accepted any blocking finding as attribution. We re-scored every committed transcript without new model calls, hand-reviewed all 94 governed-arm halts, and replaced table 2 and figures 4 and 5 with corrected values. The qualitative conclusions on contract-expressible defects (tax, residency, identity, limits, price drift) are unchanged. The aggregate correctness and cost claims are substantially revised. The validator defects behind the false alarms, and the scorer defect, have since been fixed. The fixes were validated offline by replaying all saved trial outputs; a live re-run is pending and is not reported here.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems decompose complex tasks among specialized agents that exchange intermediate state, tool outputs, and decisions. This decomposition enables parallelism, specialization, context isolation, and structured collaboration, but it also creates additional interfaces at which errors can be introduced and propagated. MAST, a large empirical taxonomy of multi-agent failures, reports 14 failure modes across system-design, inter-agent-misalignment, and task-verification categories [ 1 ] . Its current arXiv revision reports category shares of 44.2%, 32.3%, and 23.5%, respectively. In parallel, controlled scaling experiments show architecture-dependent error amplification: systems without centralized verification can amplify trace-level errors substantially more than centrally coordinated systems [ 5 ] . Recent work further studies error cascades [ 12 , 4 ] , delayed verification [ 3 ] , silent trajectory anomalies [ 9 ] , and failure attribution [ 6 , 7 , 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统将复杂任务分解给专门化的智能体，这些智能体之间会交换中间状态、工具输出和决策。 这种分解方式实现了并行性、专业化、上下文隔离和结构化协作，但也引入了额外的接口，错误可能在这些接口处产生并传播。 MAST 是一项关于多智能体失败的大型经验性分类研究，报告了系统设计、智能体间不一致以及任务验证三类问题中的 14 种失败模式 [ 1 ] 。 其当前的 arXiv 修订版本报告了这三类问题的占比分别为 44.2%、32.3% 和 23.5%。 与此同时，受控的扩展性实验表明错误放大与架构相关：没有集中验证的系统比集中协调的系统更容易显著放大痕迹级别的错误 [ 5 ] 。 近期的研究进一步探讨了错误级联 [ 12 , 4 ] 、延迟验证 [ 3 ] 、静默轨迹异常 [ 9 ] 以及失败归因问题 [ 6 , 7 , 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These studies suggest that reliability is not solely a property of the base model. It is also a property of the coordination architecture and of the interfaces through which agents exchange state. Consider a sequential workflow with n n handoffs and independent per-stage success probability p p . A simple lower-order model gives end-to-end success R ≈ p n R\approx p^{n} , illustrating why small local error rates can become operationally material as interaction depth increases. Independence is not a realistic assumption for LLM-MAS errors may be correlated and can be amplified by downstream reuse, but the multiplicative model captures the basic interface-risk intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究表明，可靠性并非仅仅是基础模型的特性。 它也是协调架构以及智能体通过其交换状态的接口的特性。 考虑一个包含 n 次交接且各阶段成功概率为 p 的序列式工作流程。 一个简单的低阶模型给出端到端成功率 R ≈ pⁿ，这说明了为何较小的局部错误率会随着交互深度的增加而在实际运行中变得显著。 对于 LLM-MAS 而言，独立性并非一个现实的假设——错误可能相互关联，并因下游重复使用而被放大，但乘法模型捕捉到了接口风险的基本直觉。

paragraphs.en: Many proposed safeguards place a learned or LLM-based evaluator in the loop; agent-as-a-judge approaches, for example, use agentic systems to evaluate other agents [ 16 , 14 ] . Such evaluators are useful, but their verdicts are themselves probabilistic and can share failure modes with the systems they assess. Maat was designed around a narrow question: can a deterministic layer prevent contract-detectable handoff defects from propagating without asking another language model to judge them? The system sits between agents and evaluates each handoff against a versioned contract describing what the workflow is authorized to do. The design intentionally separates generative reasoning from governance: agents may remain probabilistic, while the gate deciding whether a handoff violates an encoded rule is deterministic.
paragraphs.zh: 许多已提出的安全机制都在流程中引入了一个经过训练或基于大型语言模型（LLM）的评估器；例如，“智能体即法官”方法就利用智能体系统来评估其他智能体 [ 16 , 14 ] 。 这类评估器确实有用，但它们的判断本身具有概率性，并且可能与其所评估的系统存在相同的失效模式。 Maat 的设计围绕一个明确的问题展开：能否通过一个确定性层，防止合同可检测的交接缺陷继续传播，而无需让另一个语言模型对其进行评判？ 该系统位于智能体之间，通过一个版本化的合同来评估每一次交接，该合同描述了工作流程被授权执行的操作。 这一设计有意将生成性推理与治理机制分离：智能体本身可以保持概率性，而决定交接是否违反编码规则的守门机制则是确定性的。

sents.en: The system sits between agents and evaluates each handoff against a versioned contract describing what the workflow is authorized to do.
sents.zh: 该系统位于智能体之间，通过一个版本化的合同来评估每一次交接，该合同描述了工作流程被授权执行的操作。

sents.en: The design intentionally separates generative reasoning from governance: agents may remain probabilistic, while the gate deciding whether a handoff violates an encoded rule is deterministic.
sents.zh: 这一设计有意将生成性推理与治理机制分离：智能体本身可以保持概率性，而决定交接是否违反编码规则的守门机制则是确定性的。

paragraphs.en: We formalize a deterministic contract-validation layer for multi-agent handoffs and describe its seven-gate architecture at the mechanism level.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为多智能体交接构建了一个确定性的合同验证层，并在机制层面描述了其七门架构。

paragraphs.en: We report a controlled six-domain evaluation (522 trials) with deterministic, LLM-free scoring and distinguish end-to-end correctness from protective early termination.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了一项受控的六域评估（522次试验），该评估采用确定性、无大型语言模型（LLM）的评分方法，并能区分端到端的正确性与保护性的提前终止。

paragraphs.en: We identify configuration validity , especially anchor-path resolution and entity normalization as a first-class reliability requirement, including a public correction to an earlier false-positive claim.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将配置有效性，尤其是锚点路径解析和实体规范化，视为首要的可靠性要求，其中包括对先前一项误报声明的公开更正。

paragraphs.en: We position deterministic handoff governance relative to attribution, anomaly detection, learned guardrails, and propagation-aware mitigation, and formulate a testable cross-model hypothesis rather than presenting it as an established result.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将确定性移交治理置于归因、异常检测、学习型护栏和传播感知缓解的框架中进行分析，并构建了一个可检验的跨模型假设，而非将其作为既定结论提出。

paragraphs.en: A multi-agent system can fail even when every individual agent appears locally reasonable. Once an upstream agent emits a wrong value, omitted field, or inconsistent identity, downstream agents may treat that state as authoritative and construct increasingly coherent output around it. The benchmark suite was designed around this propagation pattern: discount fabrication becomes an incorrect invoice, patient-identity drift becomes a downstream safety and privacy risk, and a wrong insurance amount can become a formally explained but contractually invalid payout.
paragraphs.zh: 即使每个单独的智能体在局部看来都是合理的，一个多智能体系统仍然可能失败。 一旦上游智能体发出错误值、遗漏字段或不一致的身份信息，下游智能体可能会将该状态视为权威依据，并围绕它构建出看似越来越连贯的输出。 该基准测试套件正是基于这种传播模式设计的：伪造折扣会演变为错误的发票，患者身份信息的偏差会引发下游的安全与隐私风险，而错误的保险金额则可能最终变成一份形式上解释充分但合同上无效的赔付。

paragraphs.en: The elementary reliability calculation p n p^{n} is useful only as intuition: if each of n n sequential stages succeeds with probability p p and failures were independent, end-to-end reliability would decrease multiplicatively with workflow depth. Real LLM systems violate the independence assumption because downstream agents reuse upstream state; an early defect can therefore be amplified rather than merely accumulated. This motivates placing verification at the seam between agents instead of evaluating only the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 基础可靠性计算 p n p^{n} 仅具有启发意义：如果 n 个连续阶段中每个阶段都以概率 p 成功，且故障相互独立，那么端到端可靠性将随工作流深度呈乘数下降。 真实的 LLM 系统违反了独立性假设，因为下游智能体会重复使用上游状态；因此，早期出现的缺陷可能会被放大，而不仅仅是简单累积。 这促使我们将验证置于智能体之间的衔接处，而不是仅评估最终答案。

paragraphs.en: Three distinctions are important throughout the paper. First, structural validity is not the same as contract validity : a payload may be well formed and still violate a price, payout, tax, or authorization rule. Second, determinism is not the same as correctness : a wrongly configured deterministic rule can reproducibly produce the wrong verdict. Third, detectability is not the same as universality : Maat can reject only defects that become observable as encoded handoff or contract violations.
paragraphs.zh: 本文始终有三项重要区别。 首先，结构有效性不等于合同有效性：一个有效载荷可能构造良好，但仍可能违反价格、支付、税收或授权规则。 其次，确定性不等于正确性：一个配置错误的确定性规则可能会重复产生错误的裁决。 第三，可检测性不等于普适性：Maat 只能拒绝那些在编码移交或合同违规时变得可观察到的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: MAST provides an empirical taxonomy and annotated dataset for understanding why multi-agent systems fail [ 1 ] . Aegis scales failure-attribution research through automated, context-aware error generation and a 9,533-trajectory dataset [ 6 ] . MASPrism uses prefill-stage signals for lightweight failure attribution [ 7 ] , while VerifyMAS frames attribution as hypothesis verification [ 10 ] . These methods primarily answer where did the failure originate? Maat instead acts before the receiving agent consumes a handoff and asks does this transition satisfy an explicit contract?
paragraphs.zh: MAST 提供了一套经验性分类法和带标注的数据集，用于理解多智能体系统失败的原因 [ 1 ] 。 Aegis 通过自动化的、具备上下文感知能力的错误生成机制和一个包含 9,533 条轨迹的数据集，扩展了故障归因研究 [ 6 ] 。 MASPrism 利用预填充阶段的信号实现轻量级的故障归因 [ 7 ] ，而 VerifyMAS 则将归因问题框架化为假设验证 [ 10 ] 。 这些方法主要回答了“故障起源于何处？”这一问题。 Maat 则会在接收智能体处理移交信息之前采取行动，并询问：“这一转换是否满足明确的合同条款？”

paragraphs.en: Pathak et al. study silent failures such as drift, cycles, and missing details as anomaly detection over multi-agent trajectories [ 9 ] . Bi-level graph anomaly detection has also been proposed for fine-grained safeguarding [ 8 ] . AgentDoG develops an agentic safety taxonomy and a learned diagnostic guardrail [ 11 ] . These approaches broaden detectable behavior beyond explicit contracts, but their learned or statistical components are probabilistic. Maat makes a narrower guarantee: for a fixed engine version, configuration, anchor, and handoff, the verdict is reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: Pathak 等人研究了漂移、循环和细节缺失等静默故障，并将其视为多智能体轨迹中的异常检测问题 [ 9 ] 。 双层级图异常检测方法也被提出，用于实现精细化的安全保护 [ 8 ] 。 AgentDoG 建立了一种智能体安全分类体系，并设计了一个可学习的诊断防护机制 [ 11 ] 。 这些方法将可检测的行为范围扩展到了显式合同之外，但其可学习或统计成分具有概率性。 Maat 提供的保证更为有限：对于固定的引擎版本、配置、锚点和交接点，其判定结果具有可重复性。

paragraphs.en: From Spark to Fire models error propagation as a dependency graph and proposes a genealogy-based governance layer [ 12 ] ; PropGuard similarly targets propagation-aware exploration and remediation [ 13 ] . Hallucination Cascade studies claim-level evolution across sequential agents [ 4 ] . Itkin analyzes delayed verifier dynamics and shows that verification timing itself can affect stability in belief-update systems [ 3 ] . Maat is complementary: it does not model semantic belief dynamics; it blocks explicit structural and contract violations at the interface where they become observable.
paragraphs.zh: From Spark to Fire 将错误传播建模为依赖图，并提出了一种基于谱系的治理层 [ 12 ]；PropGuard 同样针对传播感知的探索与修复 [ 13 ]。 《幻觉级联》研究了连续智能体中论断层面的演化过程 [ 4 ]。 Itkin 分析了延迟验证器的动态特性，并指出验证时机本身可能影响信念更新系统的稳定性 [ 3 ]。 Maat 则具有互补性：它不建模语义信念的动态变化，而是在结构或契约的显式违规在接口处变得可观察时予以阻止。

paragraphs.en: Kim et al. isolate coordination architecture as a causal experimental factor and report that centralized verification bottlenecks reduce trace-level error amplification [ 5 ] . Agora, in a different setting, shows the value of durable shared state, lineage, and reproducibility for coordinating autonomous research agents [ 15 ] . These results support a broader systems view in which reliability depends on external coordination state, not only on individual model capability.
paragraphs.zh: Kim 等人将协调架构作为因果实验因素进行隔离研究，并报告称集中式验证瓶颈能够减少痕迹级别的错误放大 [ 5 ] 。 Agora 在另一种设定中展示了持久共享状态、谱系和可重复性对于协调自主研究智能体的价值 [ 15 ] 。 这些结果支持一种更广泛的系统视角：可靠性不仅取决于单个模型的能力，还依赖于外部的协调状态。

paragraphs.en: At the public-interface level, a multi-agent workflow can be represented as a directed graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) whose nodes are agents and whose edges are handoffs. Each handoff carries a structured payload together with execution metadata and relevant workflow state. Maat is inserted on selected edges and compares the observed handoff with a versioned anchor : the explicit state that the workflow is authorized to preserve or obey, such as contractual limits, approved entities, required fields, jurisdictional constraints, or policy terms.
paragraphs.zh: 在公共接口层面，多智能体工作流程可以表示为一个有向图 G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E)，其中节点是智能体，边是交接。 每次交接都携带结构化负载、执行元数据以及相关的工作流程状态。 Maat 被插入到选定的边中，并将观察到的交接与带版本锚点进行比较：即工作流程被授权保留或遵循的明确状态，例如合同限制、已批准的实体、必填字段、司法管辖区约束或政策条款。

paragraphs.en: For a fixed engine version, fixed anchor, fixed public configuration, and identical handoff state, the validator returns the same verdict. This deterministic input–output property is the reproducibility claim evaluated in this paper. We intentionally do not publish the conductor’s internal evaluation order, rule-compilation procedure, configuration-construction methodology, or implementation-specific state model. Those elements are not required to evaluate the behavioral claim and constitute part of the proprietary implementation. The formalism in this article therefore specifies the observable contract of the validator , not its internal algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 对于固定的引擎版本、固定锚点、固定公共配置以及完全相同的交接状态，验证器会返回相同的判定结果。 这种确定性的输入-输出特性，正是本文所评估的可重复性主张。 我们有意不公开协调器的内部评估顺序、规则编译流程、配置构建方法或实现特定的状态模型。 这些要素并非评估该行为主张所必需，且属于专有实现的一部分。 因此，本文的形式化方法仅定义了验证器的可观察契约，而非其内部算法。

paragraphs.en: The public architecture comprises seven gates: (G1) plan validation; (G2) handoff validation; (G3) validation-depth control; (G4) role adherence and integrity; (G5) survival/health monitoring; (G6) a circuit breaker for persistently failing agents; and (G7) cross-handoff entity consistency. Requirement primitives sit above the structural gates and encode domain rules such as payout limits, permitted discounts, tax treatment, provider eligibility, or data-residency constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 公共架构包含七个门控：(G1) 计划验证；(G2) 交接验证；(G3) 验证深度控制；(G4) 角色遵循与完整性；(G5) 生存/健康监控；(G6) 针对持续故障智能体的断路器；以及 (G7) 跨交接实体一致性。 需求原语位于结构门控之上，用于编码领域规则，例如支付限额、允许的折扣、税务处理、提供商资格或数据驻留限制。

sents.zh: 需求原语位于结构门控之上，用于编码领域规则，例如支付限额、允许的折扣、税务处理、提供商资格或数据驻留限制。

paragraphs.en: The distinction is important. Structural gates determine whether the workflow and handoff are well formed; requirement primitives determine whether a well-formed handoff is allowed by the governing contract. A syntactically valid value can still be contractually wrong. Conversely, Maat does not claim to detect every hallucination: a semantically false statement can pass if it does not violate an encoded structural or contract rule.
paragraphs.zh: 这种区别很重要。 结构门决定工作流和交接是否结构良好；需求原语则决定一个结构良好的交接是否被治理合同所允许。 一个语法上有效的值在合同上仍然可能不正确。 相反，Maat 并不声称能够检测出所有幻觉：如果一个语义上错误的陈述没有违反编码的结构或合同规则，它就可能通过验证。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the boundary mechanism can be inserted into an existing agent framework without rewriting the workflow, we implemented a CrewAI integration artifact with three layers. First, a local structural chain analyzer introspects a CrewAI Flow and deterministically reports wiring defects such as dangling edges, unreachable steps, and orphaned starts; optional produces / needs annotations enable field-level unmet-requirement checks. Second, a lightweight runtime connector inserts validate() at a handoff and performs local structural checks when no contract is configured, or calls the Maat conductor when a registered plan and anchor are supplied. Third, a minimal intake–pricing–invoice demo exercises a business-rule violation in which a structurally valid pricing payload applies a 40% discount although the registered contract authorizes only 10%. The ungoverned path accepts the arithmetic and issues the discounted invoice; the governed path rejects the pricing_to_invoice handoff with REQ_DISCOUNT_EXCEEDED .
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试边界机制能否在不重写工作流的情况下插入到现有的智能体框架中，我们实现了一个包含三层的 CrewAI 集成组件。 首先，一个本地结构链分析器会内省 CrewAI Flow，并确定性地报告连接缺陷，例如悬空边、不可达步骤和孤立起点；可选的“产出/需求”标注则支持字段级的未满足要求检查。 其次，一个轻量级运行时连接器会在任务交接处插入 validate() 函数；当未配置合同时执行本地结构检查，或在提供已注册的计划和锚点时调用 Maat 协调器。 第三，一个最小化的“接收-定价-发票”演示测试了一条业务规则违规路径：一个结构上有效的定价负载应用了 40% 的折扣，尽管已注册合同仅授权 10% 的折扣。 无管控路径会接受该计算结果并开具折扣发票；而受控路径则会因折扣超出限制而以 REQ_DISCOUNT_EXCEEDED 拒绝 pricing_to_invoice 任务交接。

paragraphs.en: This artifact is an integration demonstration rather than an additional benchmark arm. It establishes that the mechanism can operate at a concrete framework boundary and illustrates the distinction between structural validation and contract validation . Without a plan and anchor, Maat can check shape, presence, and provenance-related properties but cannot infer workflow-specific commercial limits. With the anchor configured, the same handoff can be evaluated against authorized business state. This distinction is consistent with the configuration-dependence observed in the benchmark suite and makes explicit where domain knowledge enters the system.
paragraphs.zh: 该成果是一项集成演示，而非一个额外的基准分支。 它证明了该机制能够在具体的框架边界上运行，并阐明了结构验证与合同验证之间的区别。 在没有计划和锚点的情况下，Maat 可以检查形状、存在性和来源相关的属性，但无法推断出工作流特定的商业限制。 在配置了锚点后，相同的交接过程就可以根据授权的业务状态进行评估。 这种区别与基准套件中观察到的配置依赖性一致，并明确指出了领域知识进入系统的环节。

paragraphs.en: A deterministic rule is useful only if it evaluates the intended state. Two benchmark episodes exposed the same configuration failure class: enabled rules did not correspond to the scenario state that the benchmark intended them to judge. In that state, the engine remained deterministic yet produced ineffective or false findings. This leads to a stronger system definition: the evaluated object is not the validator binary alone but the deployed combination of engine version, anchor version, and configuration state. The exact construction procedure for that configuration is intentionally outside the public paper; what the experiments show is that it must itself be tested and versioned.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性规则只有在评估预期状态时才有用。 两个基准测试用例暴露出相同的配置故障类别：启用的规则并未对应基准测试期望它们判断的场景状态。 在该状态下，引擎仍然保持确定性，却产生了无效或错误的结果。 这引出了一个更严格的系统定义：被评估的对象并非仅仅是验证器本身，而是引擎版本、锚点版本和配置状态的部署组合。 该配置的确切构建流程有意未包含在公开论文中；实验表明，它本身必须经过测试并建立版本。

paragraphs.en: Two public engineering lessons follow. First, a declared rule should be exercised against representative live-shaped payloads before validator silence is interpreted as evidence of correctness. Second, comparisons over collections should not treat semantically irrelevant reordering as a change in business state. These are observable correctness requirements; they do not disclose the proprietary rule-construction methodology.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来是两条公开的工程经验。 首先，在将验证器的沉默解释为正确性的证据之前，应对具有代表性的实时形状的有效载荷应用一条明确声明的规则。 其次，对集合进行的比较不应将语义上无关的重新排序视为业务状态的变化。 这些是可观察的正确性要求；它们并未揭示专有的规则构建方法。

paragraphs.en: Does deterministic handoff validation improve end-to-end contract correctness on controlled multi-agent workflows?
paragraphs.zh: 确定性移交验证能否提升受控多智能体工作流程中的端到端合约正确性？

paragraphs.en: When intervention stops a defective chain, how does model-call cost change relative to the ungoverned workflow?
paragraphs.zh: 当干预阻止一个有缺陷的流程链时，与不受监管的工作流相比，模型调用成本会发生怎样的变化？

paragraphs.en: Which concrete failure modes are intercepted, and which remain outside the validated coverage?
paragraphs.zh: 哪些具体的失效模式被拦截了，而哪些又处于已验证覆盖范围之外？

paragraphs.en: How sensitive are results to anchor and rule configuration?
paragraphs.zh: 结果对锚点和规则配置有多敏感？

paragraphs.en: Each domain benchmark is executed in three modes: off (unguarded baseline), warn (findings logged but execution continues), and intervene (a blocking finding terminates or redirects the chain). The reported cross-benchmark correctness and cost comparison uses the off and intervene arms. Failure profiles corrupt data or context that an agent treats as authoritative rather than merely instructing an agent to “be careless.” This choice matters because capable models often resist an explicit instruction to make an error; the benchmark is intended to study error propagation after bad state enters the workflow, not willingness to follow an obviously adversarial prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 每个领域基准测试都以三种模式执行：关闭（无防护基线）、警告（记录发现结果但继续执行）和干预（阻断性发现会终止或重定向链式流程）。 所报告的跨基准测试正确性与成本对比使用了“关闭”和“干预”两种模式。 故障特征会破坏智能体视为权威的数据或上下文，而不仅仅是让智能体“粗心大意”。这一选择至关重要，因为能力强的模型通常会抗拒明确让其出错的指令；该基准测试旨在研究不良状态进入工作流后错误的传播，而非研究模型是否愿意遵循明显具有对抗性的提示。

paragraphs.en: The public methodology uses a deterministic seven-check rubric, normalized to a 0–7 score, with no LLM judge in the scoring path. In the corrected scoring (v2), a halt receives full marks only when (i) the benchmark’s defect-present check confirms that the injected defect had entered the chain at or before the halting handoff, and (ii) the blocking finding is a specific finding rather than the generic “no provenance” signal. In the B2B workflow, a halt on a verified arithmetic inconsistency in the deal record (total ≠ \neq sum of line items) is also credited, even though that error was not injected. Any other halt is unattributed. Version 1 did not apply this rule in three of six scorers (see the revision note). The benchmark draft identifies Claude Haiku 4.5 as the single base model used across the domain runs. Consequently, model variation is not part of the present experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 公开的方法论采用一种确定性的七项检查评分标准，分数范围归一化为 0–7，且评分过程中不涉及任何 LLM 裁判。 在修正后的评分方案（v2）中，只有当以下两个条件同时满足时，一次中止才能获得满分：(i) 基准测试中的“存在缺陷”检查确认所注入的缺陷在进入中止交接点时或之前已传入链中；以及 (ii) 阻断判定是一项具体发现，而非泛泛的“无来源”信号。 在 B2B 工作流程中，即使算术不一致性并非由注入缺陷引起，只要交易记录中经核实存在此类不一致性（总数 ≠ \neq 明细项之和），中止操作也会获得相应分数。 任何其他中止均无法归因于特定原因。 版本 1 中有六个评分器中的三个未应用此规则（参见修订说明）。 基准测试草案指出，Claude Haiku 4.5 是跨所有领域运行所采用的唯一基础模型。 因此，模型差异并非当前实验的考察内容。

paragraphs.en: Software development, specification-to-release: parallel branches and repeated access to the original specification create natural redundancy, making this a useful lower-bound case for the incremental value of an external gate.

paragraphs.en: Enterprise process discovery: parallel source scanners and authorized mid-flight amendments stress scope changes, legal-approval state, and continued propagation of the amended authority.

paragraphs.en: The cost effect is conditional rather than universal. Intervention reduces cost when a blocking defect occurs early enough to avoid downstream model calls. Enterprise discovery is approximately cost-neutral because its measured defects and workflow structure do not consistently remove enough downstream work. Thus, Maat should not be described as a generic cost-reduction mechanism; it is an early-termination mechanism whose cost effect depends on defect prevalence and location. In version 1, much of the hospital and B2B saving came from false-alarm halts, which save cost only by stopping correct work.
paragraphs.zh: 成本效应是条件性的，而非普遍适用的。 当阻塞性缺陷足够早地出现，从而避免后续模型调用时，干预措施会降低成本。 企业发现机制的成本效应大致为零，因为其检测到的缺陷和流程结构并未持续消除足够的后续工作。 因此，不应将 Maat 描述为一种通用的成本降低机制；它是一种提前终止机制，其成本效应取决于缺陷的出现频率和位置。 在版本 1 中，医院和 B2B 场景中的大部分节省都来自误报导致的停止，这种停止仅通过中断正确的工作来降低成本。

paragraphs.en: The public benchmark record includes several failures for which the intended rule or entity-consistency mechanism fired:
paragraphs.zh: 公开基准记录中包含若干失败案例，在这些案例中，预期的规则或实体一致性机制已被触发：

paragraphs.en: Cross-marketplace price drift: the same SKU appeared at EUR 27.99, EUR 21.99, and EUR 19.99 across three marketplaces. A keyed entity-consistency rule detected the divergence before further propagation.
paragraphs.zh: 跨平台价格漂移：同一 SKU 在三个平台上分别标价为 27.99 欧元、21.99 欧元和 19.99 欧元。 一条基于键的实体一致性规则在数据进一步传播前检测到了这种差异。

sents.en: Cross-marketplace price drift: the same SKU appeared at EUR 27.99, EUR 21.99, and EUR 19.99 across three marketplaces.
sents.zh: 跨平台价格漂移：同一 SKU 在三个平台上分别标价为 27.99 欧元、21.99 欧元和 19.99 欧元。

sents.en: A keyed entity-consistency rule detected the divergence before further propagation.
sents.zh: 一条基于键的实体一致性规则在数据进一步传播前检测到了这种差异。

paragraphs.en: VAT/tax misclassification: jurisdiction-dependent tax treatment was caught in e-commerce and insurance scenarios when the defect manifested.
paragraphs.zh: 增值税/税款分类错误：在电子商务和保险场景中，当缺陷显现时，发现了因司法管辖区不同而导致的税务处理问题。

paragraphs.en: Payout inflation: an insurance scenario propagated EUR 1,310 where the contract-correct payout was EUR 810; a value-mismatch rule halted the governed chain before payment propagation.
paragraphs.zh: 赔付通胀：一个保险场景传播了 1,310 欧元，而合同规定的正确赔付金额为 810 欧元；一条价值不匹配规则在支付传播前阻止了受管链。

paragraphs.en: Claimant identity drift: a changed policyholder identifier was detected through cross-handoff entity tracking.
paragraphs.zh: 索赔人身份漂移：通过跨移交实体追踪检测到保单持有人标识符发生变动。

paragraphs.en: Data residency: a scenario marking special-category medical data for non-EU processing triggered a configured residency rule.
paragraphs.zh: 数据驻留：一个将特殊类别医疗数据标记为不在欧盟境内处理的场景，触发了已配置的数据驻留规则。

paragraphs.en: Un-injected revenue mis-report: an e-commerce analytics agent repeatedly double-counted marketplace revenue without the benchmark explicitly injecting that particular error; in version 1 the configured validator recorded it only as a warning and did not stop the chain (it is a blocking rule since v2).
paragraphs.zh: 未注入的收入误报：一个电商分析智能体在没有基准明确注入该特定错误的情况下，重复计算了平台收入；在版本 1 中，配置的验证器仅将其记录为警告，并未停止流程（自版本 2 起，这已成为一条阻断规则）。

paragraphs.en: These examples demonstrate contract and state consistency, not open-domain factuality. A fluent but wrong statement with no corresponding anchor rule remains outside the mechanism’s guaranteed coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 这些例子展示了合同和状态的一致性，而非开放领域的真实性。 一个流畅但错误的陈述，如果没有对应的锚定规则，仍然处于该机制保证覆盖范围之外。

paragraphs.en: We read every one of the 94 halts in the intervention arms of the six workflows. In 45 the halt stopped the injected defect. In 13 it stopped a genuine defect that was not injected: deal totals inconsistent with line items, a missing required field, and an out-of-network payout. One was a legitimate escalation, where the agent could not determine a payout. The remaining 35 (37%) were false alarms on correct output: 17 of 22 halts in hospital triage, 8 of 20 in B2B, 6 of 22 in insurance, 3 of 7 in software development, 1 of 18 in e-commerce and 0 of 5 in enterprise discovery. The causes were validator defects, not model behaviour:
paragraphs.zh: 我们阅读了六个工作流程中干预组里全部 94 个停止案例。 在 45 个案例中，停止机制阻止了注入的缺陷。 在 13 个案例中，它阻止了一个未注入的真实缺陷：交易总额与明细项目不一致、缺少必填字段以及超出网络范围的付款。 其中一个属于合理的升级情况，当时智能体无法确定付款金额。 其余 35 个（37%）是正确输出引发的误报：医院分诊中有 22 个停止案例中的 17 个、B2B 中有 20 个中的 8 个、保险中有 22 个中的 6 个、软件开发中有 7 个中的 3 个、电子商务中有 18 个中的 1 个，以及企业探索中 5 个中的 0 个。 其原因是验证器缺陷，而非模型行为：

sents.zh: 我们阅读了六个工作流程中干预组里全部 94 个停止案例。

sents.en: In 45 the halt stopped the injected defect.
sents.zh: 在 45 个案例中，停止机制阻止了注入的缺陷。

sents.en: In 13 it stopped a genuine defect that was not injected: deal totals inconsistent with line items, a missing required field, and an out-of-network payout.
sents.zh: 在 13 个案例中，它阻止了一个未注入的真实缺陷：交易总额与明细项目不一致、缺少必填字段以及超出网络范围的付款。

sents.en: One was a legitimate escalation, where the agent could not determine a payout.
sents.zh: 其中一个属于合理的升级情况，当时智能体无法确定付款金额。

sents.en: The remaining 35 (37%) were false alarms on correct output: 17 of 22 halts in hospital triage, 8 of 20 in B2B, 6 of 22 in insurance, 3 of 7 in software development, 1 of 18 in e-commerce and 0 of 5 in enterprise discovery.
sents.zh: 其余 35 个（37%）是正确输出引发的误报：医院分诊中有 22 个停止案例中的 17 个、B2B 中有 20 个中的 8 个、保险中有 22 个中的 6 个、软件开发中有 7 个中的 3 个、电子商务中有 18 个中的 1 个，以及企业探索中 5 个中的 0 个。

sents.en: The causes were validator defects, not model behaviour:
sents.zh: 其原因是验证器缺陷，而非模型行为：

paragraphs.en: (22 halts) Circuit-breaker state carried over from earlier trials escalated validation to its strictest depth. At that depth provenance became mandatory, and the provenance check recognised only a top-level key, so it ignored field-level and per-item provenance that the agents had supplied.
paragraphs.zh: （22 停止）从先前试验中继承的断路器状态将验证提升到了最严格的深度。 在该深度下，来源信息变得强制要求，而来源检查仅识别顶层密钥，因此忽略了智能体提供的字段级和逐项来源信息。

sents.en: (22 halts) Circuit-breaker state carried over from earlier trials escalated validation to its strictest depth.
sents.zh: （22 停止）从先前试验中继承的断路器状态将验证提升到了最严格的深度。

sents.en: At that depth provenance became mandatory, and the provenance check recognised only a top-level key, so it ignored field-level and per-item provenance that the agents had supplied.
sents.zh: 在该深度下，来源信息变得强制要求，而来源检查仅识别顶层密钥，因此忽略了智能体提供的字段级和逐项来源信息。

paragraphs.en: (8) A legitimately empty answer, such as no declared allergies or no documented history, was treated as a hollow handoff.
paragraphs.zh: （8）合法的空值答案，例如未声明任何过敏情况或没有记录在案的历史，都被视为一次空洞的移交。

paragraphs.en: (4) Correct EUR 0 denials were compared with a payable-claim expected amount.
paragraphs.zh: (4) 正确的 0 欧元拒绝金额与应付款项的预期金额进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: (1) Per-country transaction counts were parsed as tax rates.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 各国的交易次数被解析为税率。

paragraphs.en: Because the benchmark scorers credited these halts, the version 1 table counted them as successes.
paragraphs.zh: 由于基准评分者将这些停止状态计入了得分，因此版本 1 的表格将它们视为成功。

paragraphs.en: The strongest negative result is also the most operationally useful. An earlier internal benchmark snapshot reported zero false positives on the deterministic rubric. The later public repository documents 11 false-positive findings in the health-insurance benchmark, concentrated in REQ_VALUE_MISMATCH and INFO_EMPTY on two profiles where the model correctly denied a claim while the anchor’s expected payout still represented the clean-claim case. This is not model nondeterminism: it is a mismatch between the validator’s expected value and the scenario state.
paragraphs.zh: 最严重的负面结果同时也是在操作层面最有用的结果。 一份早期的内部基准测试快照报告称，在确定性评估标准中未出现任何误报。 后续公开的仓库文件记录了健康保险基准测试中的 11 起误报案例，这些案例主要集中在两个配置文件中的 REQ_VALUE_MISMATCH 和 INFO_EMPTY 问题上；在这些案例中，模型正确地拒绝了理赔申请，而基准模型预期的赔付金额仍然对应于无异常理赔的情况。 这并非模型的非确定性，而是验证器预期值与场景状态之间的不匹配。

paragraphs.en: Accordingly, determinism should not be confused with correctness. Determinism means that the same misconfigured rule will fail in the same way every time. The practical benefit is diagnosability and reproducibility; the practical burden is that anchor construction and scenario-conditioned expected values must themselves be tested.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，不应将决定论与正确性混为一谈。 决定论意味着，相同的配置错误规则每次都会以相同的方式失败。 实际上的好处是具备可诊断性和可重复性；而实际负担则在于，锚点构建和基于场景条件的预期值本身也必须经过测试。

sents.en: Accordingly, determinism should not be confused with correctness.
sents.zh: 因此，不应将决定论与正确性混为一谈。

sents.en: Determinism means that the same misconfigured rule will fail in the same way every time.
sents.zh: 决定论意味着，相同的配置错误规则每次都会以相同的方式失败。

sents.en: The practical benefit is diagnosability and reproducibility; the practical burden is that anchor construction and scenario-conditioned expected values must themselves be tested.
sents.zh: 实际上的好处是具备可诊断性和可重复性；而实际负担则在于，锚点构建和基于场景条件的预期值本身也必须经过测试。

paragraphs.en: Separate public tests stress mechanisms not naturally exercised by data-corruption domain scenarios. The reported circuit-breaker benchmark shows 0% false trips on a healthy pipeline, 100% trips under an engineered chronic-failure profile, and approximately 37% lower cost than running the chronically failing agent without the breaker. A validation-depth sweep reports four additional findings per trial under thorough versus light validation and a lower aggregate cost on defective traffic because earlier halts skip downstream calls. Survival monitoring is characterized as calibration-dependent rather than governed by a universal threshold. These results should be read as targeted mechanism tests; they do not establish that every gate is equally validated across the six domain workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 独立的公开测试会对数据损坏领域场景下自然无法触发的机制施加压力。 所报告的断路器基准测试显示：在正常流程中，误触发率为 0%；在人为设计的慢性故障配置下，触发率为 100%；且与在没有断路器的情况下运行慢性故障智能体相比，成本降低了约 37%。 一次验证深度扫描报告称，在彻底验证与轻度验证的对比中，每次试验都发现了四项额外发现，并且在缺陷流量场景下的总成本更低，因为更早的停止会跳过下游调用。 生存性监测的特征是依赖校准，而非由通用阈值所决定。 这些结果应被理解为针对特定机制的测试；它们并未证明所有门控机制在这六个领域工作流程中都具有同等程度的验证。

paragraphs.en: The experiments suggest that deterministic boundary governance is most useful when a workflow carries a stable, inspectable source of authority and when expensive or regulated consequences occur downstream of the violating handoff. Examples include insurance policies, contractual price limits, financial authorizations, tax rules, data-residency requirements, approved identities, clinical protocol constraints, and service-level obligations.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，当工作流程具备稳定且可核查的权威来源，并且违规交接的下游环节会产生高成本或受监管的后果时，确定性的边界治理最为有效。 例如，保险政策、合同价格限制、金融授权、税务规则、数据驻留要求、经批准的身份、临床方案约束以及服务级别义务等。

sents.en: The experiments suggest that deterministic boundary governance is most useful when a workflow carries a stable, inspectable source of authority and when expensive or regulated consequences occur downstream of the violating handoff.
sents.zh: 实验表明，当工作流程具备稳定且可核查的权威来源，并且违规交接的下游环节会产生高成本或受监管的后果时，确定性的边界治理最为有效。

sents.en: Examples include insurance policies, contractual price limits, financial authorizations, tax rules, data-residency requirements, approved identities, clinical protocol constraints, and service-level obligations.

paragraphs.en: It is less compelling when downstream agents already possess strong independent redundancy, when there is no stable contract to encode, or when the target failure is purely semantic and cannot be reduced to a checkable invariant. The software-development benchmark illustrates the first case: agents frequently re-derive upstream requirements, so external governance adds less. A hallucinated explanation that violates no encoded state illustrates the second: the statement may be false yet still pass a contract layer.
paragraphs.zh: 当下游智能体已经具备强大的独立冗余能力时，当没有稳定的契约可供编码时，或者当目标故障纯粹是语义性的且无法简化为可检查的不变量时，这种论点就缺乏说服力。 软件开发基准展示了第一种情况：智能体经常重新推导出上游需求，因此外部治理带来的增益有限。 一种不违反任何已编码状态的幻觉性解释则展示了第二种情况：该陈述可能为假，但仍能通过契约层检查。

paragraphs.en: The public design supports two operational postures. In warn mode , selected handoffs are checked and findings are recorded while the workflow continues. This is the appropriate starting posture for a new anchor because the organization can observe what would have been blocked while configuration is calibrated. In intervene mode , findings designated as blocking halt the chain or route execution to recovery. Only intervention can create the measured downstream cost saving because only intervention prevents later model calls after a detected defect. Routing a blocked handoff to a human reviewer, rather than letting the chain continue or silently repairing the payload, is one way to support the human-oversight requirements that the EU AI Act sets for high-risk systems [ 2 ] ; the validator on its own does not constitute compliance.
paragraphs.zh: 该公共设计支持两种运行模式。 在“警告”模式下，系统会检查选定的交接操作并记录发现结果，同时工作流程继续执行。 这是新锚点的合适初始模式，因为组织可以在校准配置的同时观察到原本会被阻断的内容。 在“干预”模式下，被标记为阻断的发现结果将中止链式流程或转向恢复流程。 只有干预措施才能实现可量化的下游成本节约，因为只有干预措施能防止在检测到缺陷后继续调用模型。 将被阻断的交接操作转交给人工审核员，而不是让流程继续执行或静默修复负载，是满足欧盟《人工智能法案》对高风险系统提出的人工监督要求的一种方式 [2]；仅靠验证器本身并不构成合规。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark suite supports a limited but meaningful conclusion: when a defect is expressible as a deterministic predicate over the current handoff, prior tracked state, and a correctly configured contract, inline validation can prevent that defect from reaching later agents. This is especially useful for quantities and identities expected to remain stable across handoffs, explicit eligibility rules, limits, and jurisdictional constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试套件支持一个有限但具有意义的结论：当某个缺陷能够表示为当前移交、先前跟踪状态以及正确配置的合同之上的确定性谓词时，内联验证可以防止该缺陷传播到后续的智能体。 对于期望在移交过程中保持稳定的数量和身份、明确的资格规则、限制以及管辖约束而言，这一点尤其有用。

paragraphs.en: This observation aligns with architecture-level evidence that validation bottlenecks can reduce error propagation [ 5 ] . It also complements attribution work [ 6 , 7 , 10 ] : attribution explains a failed trajectory after the fact, whereas contract gating can stop some trajectories before the downstream effect occurs. The two functions are not substitutes.
paragraphs.zh: 这一观察结果与架构层面的证据一致，即验证瓶颈会减少错误传播 [ 5 ]。 这也补充了归因研究 [ 6 , 7 , 10 ]：归因是在事后解释一条失败的轨迹，而合同门控则可以在下游影响发生之前阻止某些轨迹。 这两种功能并非相互替代的。

paragraphs.en: First, the experiments do not establish general hallucination detection. Maat cannot reject an incorrect assertion simply because it is false unless falsity manifests as a configured contract or consistency violation. Second, the evaluation uses a single base model and therefore cannot establish model-independent utility. Third, observed benchmark improvements are descriptive; the present public result tables do not provide the per-trial distributions needed for inferential claims. Fourth, the workflows are controlled simulations of operational domains, not prospective deployments inside hospitals, insurers, or production marketplaces.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，这些实验并未确立通用的幻觉检测能力。 除非错误性表现为已配置的合同或一致性违反，否则 Maat 无法仅因某个断言为假而拒绝该断言。 其次，评估仅使用了一个基础模型，因此无法确立与特定模型无关的效用。 第三，观察到的基准测试改进仅具有描述性；当前的公开结果表并未提供进行推断性结论所需的单次试验分布数据。 第四，这些工作流程是对运营领域的受控模拟，而非在医院、保险公司或生产市场中的前瞻性部署。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the false-positive revision shows that an audit-friendly deterministic layer can still be wrong because its specification is wrong. This shifts part of the engineering problem from “how do we judge agent output?” to “how do we validate the contract representation that performs the judging?” We view that shift as desirable because specification errors are inspectable, testable, and versionable, but it is not free.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，这个误判的修订表明，即使是一个便于审计的确定性层，也可能因为其规范错误而仍然出错。 这将工程问题的一部分从“我们如何判断智能体的输出？”转移到了“我们如何验证执行判断的契约表示？”我们认为这种转移是有益的，因为规范错误可以被检查、测试和版本化，但这并非没有代价。

paragraphs.en: For defects that are representable by a fixed deterministic contract, the validator’s verdict is invariant to the model used by the producing agent, while the frequency with which such defects manifest is model-dependent.
paragraphs.zh: 对于可通过固定确定性合约表示的缺陷，验证者的裁决不受生产智能体所用模型的影响，而此类缺陷出现的频率则取决于具体模型。

paragraphs.en: A direct test is a paired cross-model experiment: hold workflow, seeds, anchor, injections, and validator version fixed; replace only the base model with a stronger and a cost-optimized model; measure (i) defect manifestation rate, (ii) validator recall conditional on manifestation, (iii) false-positive findings, and (iv) total cost. The prediction is not that weaker models make every defect more often, but that the deterministic conditional detection behavior remains stable once the same violating handoff occurs.
paragraphs.zh: 直接测试是一种配对跨模型实验：保持工作流、种子值、锚点、注入项和验证器版本不变；仅将基础模型替换为更强且成本优化的模型；测量（i）缺陷显现率，（ii）在缺陷显现条件下验证器的召回率，（iii）误报结果，以及（iv）总成本。 预测并非较弱模型会导致所有缺陷更频繁出现，而是指一旦发生相同的违规传递行为，其确定性的条件检测行为将保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark methodology and public result files are available at https://github.com/Lorelys/maat-benchmarks . The project page is https://maat.synwe.ai/ . The public benchmark repository reports benchmark designs, per-benchmark summaries, gate analyses, and consolidated tables. In addition, a CrewAI integration artifact provides a local deterministic structural analyzer, a handoff connector, a recorded verdict replay, and a minimal business-rule demo. paragraphs.en: We presented Maat, a deterministic contract-based governance layer for multi-agent LLM workflows. Across six controlled domain benchmarks, corrected results show improvements where halts are attributable to real defects (five of six workflows on the paired subset). A hand review, however, found that 37% of version 1 halts were false alarms caused by validator defects, and the originally reported gains on every workflow do not survive attribution-aware scoring. More importantly, the benchmark history exposes the central engineering constraint: determinism does not remove specification risk. Anchor construction, path resolution, expected-value semantics, and entity normalization are part of the system and must be validated and versioned with the result. Maat is therefore best understood not as a universal AI judge, but as an external deterministic boundary for the subset of agent behavior that can be made explicit as contracts and state invariants. The next decisive experiment is cross-model replication with fixed contracts and identical defect profiles.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Maat，这是一个基于确定性合约的多智能体 LLM 工作流治理层。 在六个受控领域基准测试中，修正后的结果显示，当停止是由于真实缺陷引起时（配对子集中六个工作流中的五个），性能得到了提升。 然而，人工审查发现，版本 1 中 37% 的停止是验证器缺陷引起的误报，并且最初报告的所有工作流中的性能提升在考虑归因后的评分中并不成立。 更重要的是，基准测试的历史暴露了核心的工程约束：确定性并不能消除规格风险。 锚点构建、路径解析、期望值语义和实体标准化都是系统的一部分，必须与结果一同进行验证和版本控制。 因此，Maat 不应被理解为一个通用的 AI 裁判，而应被视为一个外部确定性边界，用于约束那些可以明确表达为合约和状态不变量的智能体行为子集。 下一个决定性的实验是，在固定合约和相同缺陷配置下，进行跨模型的重复验证。

paragraphs.en: For each reported gate or primitive, the following states should be distinguished before drawing a conclusion from a non-firing validator:
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个报告的门或原语，在从非触发验证器中得出结论之前，应区分以下状态：

paragraphs.en: Not exercised: the benchmark never creates the corresponding defect.
paragraphs.zh: 未触发：基准测试从未创建相应的缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Pre-empted: an earlier blocking finding prevents the workflow from reaching the intended check.
paragraphs.zh: 被抢占：先前的阻断发现阻止了工作流到达预期的检查点。

paragraphs.en: Self-corrected: the agent repairs or rejects the injected corruption, so no violating handoff is emitted.
paragraphs.zh: 自我纠正：智能体会修复或拒绝注入的损坏，因此不会发出任何违规的移交。

paragraphs.en: Misconfigured: the rule is enabled but reads the wrong field, wrong scenario expectation, or wrong entity representation.
paragraphs.zh: 配置错误：规则已启用，但读取了错误的字段、错误的情景预期或错误的实体表示。

paragraphs.en: True negative: the relevant handoff is valid and the rule correctly remains silent.
paragraphs.zh: 真阴性：相关移交有效，且规则正确地保持静默。

paragraphs.en: This taxonomy prevents “no alert” from being conflated with “validated correct.”
paragraphs.zh: 这种分类法可防止将“无警报”与“经验证正确”混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: Two interpretation rules are important. First, the first blocking verdict is not always the mechanism originally associated with the injected profile: an earlier or orthogonal rule can pre-empt a downstream check. Second, a non-firing intended rule does not imply that the workflow was valid; it may have been pre-empted, self-corrected by the model, or misconfigured. These cases are separated explicitly in Appendix B.
paragraphs.zh: 两条解释规则很重要。 首先，第一个阻断判定并不总是最初与注入配置文件相关联的机制：一个更早或正交的规则可能会优先于下游的检查执行。 其次，一条未触发的预期规则并不意味着工作流程有效；它可能已被优先执行、被模型自我纠正，或者配置错误。 这些情况在附录 B 中被明确区分。
